h: Makinde's 2027 presidential bid is a 'water-testing' move rather than a serious push to win, analyst says
p: An analyst has reportedly described Oyo State Governor Seyi Makinde's presidential ambition as an exploratory move rather than a bid built to win. The comment adds to the debate over who can challenge for the presidency as campaigns by the APC, NDC and ADC get under way.
more: The analysis is one of several on how the 2027 field is shaping up.
Supporters of the governor have not been quoted in the report.
